w:r.w:t: Entrepreneur | Supply Chain Strategist | Business Builder | Strategic Leader

Abhilash Raju Amula is a supply-chain entrepreneur and business leader with nearly two decades of experience across integrated supply chain, logistics, operations, business development and network transformation.

He is the Founder and CEO of ReeferON Supply Chain Solutions, where he focuses on building an integrated food supply-chain platform combining cold storage, dry warehousing, transportation, technology and operational execution. His work is centred on creating a scalable and technology-enabled supply-chain ecosystem.

Before building ReeferON, Abhilash held leadership roles across organisations including DHL, DP World, Reliance, CHEP, Radhakrishna Foodland, Rivigo and Danisco. His experience spans supply-chain network design, operations, business growth, strategic planning, P&L management and building high-performance teams.

Abhilash is also a Co-Founder of PAR 360 Integrated Supply Chain, alongside Rajesh Shetty and Prakash Ghagare. PAR 360 is being built around an integrated supply-chain model covering strategy, planning, warehousing, transportation, technology, analytics and execution.
At Eighty Three Ventures, Abhilash brings entrepreneurial leadership, deep supply-chain expertise and an execution-focused mindset to identifying, building and scaling businesses.
